title: tc-knowledge-promotion
description:
Promote a verified fact into shared team knowledge: the fact with any disputed versions beside it, a checklist of
required and recommended conditions with who met them and when, and Promote and Dispute.

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

scope.description: Where the knowledge goes or what it covers, a quiet line under the heading – e.g. "Acme lease review"

conditions.description: The checklist, in order – required conditions block Promote, recommended ones only warn

versions.description: Disputed versions of the fact, shown side by side with it

threshold.description: Confidence the fact needs, 0–1 – checked when `fact.confidence` is set

thresholdOptional.description: Makes the confidence condition recommended instead of required

error.description: Why the last promotion failed – shown above the actions; Promote tries again

disputing.description: The dispute form is open – set false to close it after a prevented tc-dispute

noDispute.description: Hides Dispute, for people who can promote but not dispute

required.description: Required conditions block Promote; recommended ones (false) only warn. Default true

at.description: When, as the app formats it

detail.description: A short line under the label – what it waits on, or what was checked

note.description: Why – "The March filing says 14 days, not 10"

KnowledgeVersion.description: A disputed version of the fact, shown beside it
